ck.tab.yesterday: Checklist tab button, bottom row beside Today: the day before today. One short word, no full stop.
ck.tab.tomorrow: Checklist tab button, bottom row beside Today: the day after today. One short word, no full stop.
ck.tab_hint.yesterday: Hover hint on the Yesterday tab: what the tab lists. Match the Today tab's hint.
ck.tab_hint.tomorrow: Hover hint on the Tomorrow tab: what the tab lists. Match the Today tab's hint.
ck.add.yesterday: Placeholder in the add box while the Yesterday tab is open. A to-do typed here is dated yesterday.
ck.add.tomorrow: Placeholder in the add box while the Tomorrow tab is open. A to-do typed here is dated tomorrow.
ck.week_range: Checklist header on the This week tab: the first and last day of the week, each already formatted like the Today tab header (month, day, short weekday). Use the range mark your language puts between two dates.
ck.menu_hide_tags: Checklist right-click submenu listing every tag (#name). A ticked tag keeps entries with that tag out of this checklist only; the entries stay in the calendar and other widgets. Short menu label, no full stop.
